name: MyMonero
description: In the retrieved MyMonero checkout, packaged non-Linux builds use electron-updater. The controller starts with download and install-on-quit disabled, checks for updates automatically, prompts before downloading when automatic download is off, and prompts before quitting to install. The build configuration names a Windows certificate subject and invokes a macOS notarization hook.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; packaging hooks/configuration do not prove that a particular published artifact was successfully signed or notarized, and electron-updater's internal enforcement is not reimplemented here.
